title: The owner's third round on 4c442e95: a piloted gun's barrel follows the reticle at a servo rate and aims at the body the player sees, the reticle says why the gun is quiet; nothing is drawn over a sinkhole (a blob climbs the lip, the record starts past it); four hits a hull and a hard core pushed aside; one hull console over the radar; a VARS playtest page; soft Pearl tiers smaller and faster, cored bigger; the cave's drone hands
context: Twelve notes. 1) the Rotor: the reticle moved and the fire lagged behind it, the gun went quiet without turning red, the hitbox read as random, the first batch rose out of the ground; 2) enemies must never stand over the sinkhole's dark centre: a fake blob emerging on the periphery, the rammable record made already out; 3) MÖRK lost to one hard core: four hits, and ramming a hard core pushes it aside and damages the tank; 4) the km/h line, the cruise readout and Isao's card fought for one corner; 5) spots where the tank looks like it fits but cannot pass (screenshots not received); 6) an easy way to play or replay a sector and set the enemies' speed; 7, 11, 12) the boss is the Nih-Dairia in an arena far from the base (its own design, 2026-10-16-arena-design); 8) soft enemies smaller but faster, cored slightly bigger; 9, 10) the cave: a screenshot's Shift crashed Isao, tentacles floating, drone controls. The seat's lag was the mount's own drive (SENTRY_TUNE.yawRate 110 deg/s, the 2.5-degree tolerance gate) between a free reticle and a barrel that fires along itself; the misalignment was the second round's choice to aim at the record while a Pearl body hunts ahead of it.
outcome: The seat: a piloted gun turns SENTRY_TUNE.manualDrive (4) times the drive rate (src/fx/tower-aim.js; a launcher keeps its rate); the head, the slug, the beam, the tracer and the guided round all take the body's drawn point (groundAt), the box tests the body first and the record second (src/sentry-pilot.js); src/domain/seat-status.js gives the readout's word and the reticle's state (overheated red and blinking, traversing amber, out of range dim) with a heat bar under the cross (app.css). The lip: EMERGENCE.out 1.35 (the record starts past the lip, under the ground for `climb` 1.1 s while a blob of its tint crests the lip and slides out, src/fx/emerge-blob.js over src/domain/emerge-climb.js, then pops up over `pop` 0.3 s and walks); the harness's 'risen' mark (emergeAge 1.2) is set when the pop ends. The hull: HULL_ARMOUR.hits 4 (src/content/tank.js; the MK-9's burn takes it whole), a dent flashes the frame and the console, the drawn wear blends the hulls left and the armour; a touched hard core takes the shield's shove and stun and PEARL_IMPACT.contact.cored 0.4 (the hull keeps most of its speed). The console: src/fx/hull-console.js (MÖRK and its armour pips, the km/h, MANUAL / CRUISE / the directive) over the radar, the throttle lever beside the radar on a desktop, Isao's card above the line. VARS: a playtest page (the sector to open, PLAY, REPLAY THIS SECTOR, the enemy speed knob; ?speed= carried). Sizes: PEARL_BODY.scale soft 0.85 / cored 1.12 on the record, the body, the reach and the box together; PEARL_PACE white and yellow 1.15 with caps over the smaller body (1.18 / 1), blue 1.08 at cap 1 (1.06 / 1.15 sat on the motion audit's acceleration bound). The cave (stalheart-cave, imported): W S fly and A D turn, no strafe; a key with the command or control key held clears the keys; a limb is not made where its wall is cut away by another tunnel or the chamber. Note 5 waits for the screenshots; notes 7, 11 and 12 are the arena's design.
alternatives: Snap a piloted head to the reticle with no rate: rejected, the barrels would never be seen swinging; a servo four times the drive reaches a 46-degree flick in 0.12 s and keeps the motor.
Keep the box on the record and lead the tracer to the body: the second round tried the reverse and the owner saw the misalignment either way; everything on the body is one point.
A hull hit-point bar on the integrity strip: built, then moved to the console so the hull's three readouts are one line.
A pointer:fine media query for the lever's desktop place: headless Chrome reports no fine pointer; the shell's own body class decides.
evidence: test/seat-status.mjs, test/tower-aim.mjs (the servo, the body's point), test/emerge-climb.mjs, test/hull-console.mjs, test/pearl-motion.mjs (the audit at the new paces), test/pearl-enemies.mjs; node 265 green; browser --seats --laser-game --sinkhole --sectors --boss-start --descent --gunship-auto --canyon --skip-tutorial; the cave's 33 tests
scratchpad captures of the tank view before and after: the lever, the km/h and Isao's card in one corner; the console line over the radar and the lever beside it
